name: After § 101
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 101a. Underlines that primary responsibility for the organisation, conduct and supervision of elections lies with the Member States, subject to applicable EU law; rejects the creation, whether through legislation, soft law or administrative practice, of any general EU-level monitoring or supervisory role over national electoral processes for which no explicit Treaty basis exists;
